AI Video Editor Kapwing — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release with support for uploading, editing, captioning, and exporting short video clips by text instruction.
- 100 free credits for new users via automatic anonymous token generation; requires no local install.
- Simple workflow: drop any common video file, describe edits (e.g. trim, add subtitles, resize), receive a downloadable 1080p MP4.
- Fast cloud GPU processing; most edits complete in 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in session management, credit checks, and error handling for a smooth, guided experience.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM and other major media formats up to 500MB.
